resources.string: Compare the real cost. Build the smarter basket.

Enter each product in its own box, then confirm they are like-for-like alternatives. ValuePilot compares exact package size and price facts on-device and refuses to rank when those facts are not safe enough.

Put the product name, package size and current price in the same box. To compare member prices, add a clearly labeled member price too. Use a concrete currency such as CA$ or US$ instead of a bare $. Blank lines inside a product are fine.
Honeycrisp apples 3 lb Current price CA$5.99 Member price CA$4.99
This saved product entry was too long and was not restored. Re-enter it more briefly.
Confirm only when every product is a substitute you would reasonably choose between. Editing or adding a product clears this confirmation.
Choose the price you want to compare. A missing member price stays unranked; ValuePilot never substitutes a current price.
Enter two or more products before comparing exact value.
Confirm that every product is a like-for-like alternative before comparing exact value.
Tap Compare exact value to evaluate the confirmed products.
Enter at least two products to compare
The standalone comparison above does not require Accessibility access. If you want experimental live capture from another shopping app, you can enable the optional scanner here.

ValuePilot uses Android Accessibility access only for its optional live-capture feature. It can read product or menu text in the app currently on screen and show the floating comparison panel. Off-screen collection and OCR remain user initiated. Parsing, ranking, the compact classifier and OCR run locally. This build has no INTERNET permission and does not upload screen contents, account credentials or shopping data.

Standalone comparison, deterministic parsing and exact value evaluation run on-device. This build has no INTERNET permission and does not send your product text, screen contents, credentials or shopping data to a server.

Automatically reads newly visible product and menu labels in the active app so ValuePilot can compare exact unit value and clearly labeled local estimates. It scrolls only when you explicitly choose off-screen collection; this build has no internet permission.
Use ValuePilot standalone comparison for normal product comparison. Accessibility capture, off-screen collection and OCR remain optional experimental tools.
Type your grocery list in plain language. ValuePilot asks only when something genuinely needs clarification.
Search stays separate for item-by-item value. Direct product comparison remains available as a secondary tool.
Optional preferences are saved with this list. The fictional sample plan total stays unchanged until a verified planner mapping is introduced.
This is your preference, not proof of product identity. A verified product match is still required before any planner can use it.

Select a name to replace the unresolved list word. Review the list, then tap Plan My Shop. This only edits the Home list; the fictional sample planner may still leave the inserted name unresolved, and this does not confirm an exact product.
Type a product or tap a quick search. ValuePilot cuts through package sizes and prices so the strongest value rises first.
This search prototype uses built-in fictional sample products. It does not claim live retailer prices, stock, promotions or availability.
